media:group.media:title: Prada Holiday 2026 Campaign | "Drawing Prada: Animated by Hand"
media:group.media:description:
Introducing “Drawing Prada”, the Prada Holiday 2026 campaign. A Prada fantasy, created by hand. The Prada Holiday 2026 campaign draws inspiration from the human core of storytelling at the heart of the holiday season. It invents encompassing fantasies, magical impossibilities created by the anachronistic and romantic technique of hand-drawn illustration, the true protagonist for a series of films. Starring Prada Ambassadors Sadie Sink, Maya Hawke, Chen Haoyu, Kelvin Harrison Jr., together with Luther Ford – at its heart the Prada Holiday 2026 campaign is a celebration of craft and process. These subjects are embedded in wonderlands of hand-drawn illustration created by artists led by John Pomeroy, a legendary cinematic animator whose eye has helped define some of the leading productions of the past fifty years.
Creative Directors: Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons Photographer and director: Glen Luchford Animation direction: John Pomeroy Talent: Sadie Sink, Maya Hawke, Chen Haoyu, Kelvin Harrison Jr., Luther Ford Campaign Creative Direction: Ferdinando Verderi

entry.title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet

media:group.media:title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet
media:group.media:description:
151.83 km/h. The fastest speed ever recorded on a skateboard. Prada Linea Rossa joins Red Bull athlete and two-time downhill world champion Diego Poncelet in the Skateboard Speed World Record project, supporting his pursuit of a historic milestone. On a closed section of Route des Éboulements in Québec, Canada, Poncelet surpasses the previous world record following years of research, training, and technical development. Working closely with the athlete, Prada Linea Rossa developed bespoke footwear and gloves, combining high-performance materials with protection, comfort, and grip. Every detail contributed to a system engineered for control at extreme speeds. A new chapter in the ongoing partnership between Prada Linea Rossa and Red Bull, challenging conventions and redefining the boundaries of human performance.

media:group.media:description:
The simple, the honest and human inform “Simple Stories”, the Prada Fall/Winter 2026 campaign. media:group.media:title: Made in Prada | The Making of Fall/Winter 2026 Look #10
media:group.media:description:
For Prada Fall/Winter 2026 Look #10, devoré becomes a form of revelation. The technique transforms the surface through subtraction, gradually exposing hidden layers and allowing the material to carry evidence of its own transformation. What appears altered becomes a record of process, memory and change. The final piece retains visible traces of its own making, a unique expression of Prada’s craftsmanship in which imperfection, memory and transformation become signifiers of authenticity.
